why: the trainer receipt field is named predictions_sha256 but it is the hash of the WHOLE .npz, which also stores a per-anchor model_sha256 array. With n_jobs=8 a few LightGBM leaf values move in the 17th significant digit, so the model text and therefore the file hash change on every run while P does not. Anyone comparing runs by that field will see differences that are not there -- I did. This records the hash of P ITSELF, which is the quantity the name promises.
cross_reference: nc_2026-09-23/receipts/king_env_2026-09-24/KING_ENV_P_INVARIANCE.json (integrator): P bitwise invariant across 6 environment variants; 4 identical runs gave 4 different file hashes
recommendation_adopted: compare King outputs by P (or a hash of P alone), never by the npz file hash
